lanes.title: Native protocol and single job integrator
Host launcher, build stages and CLI writer

tasks.title: Freeze source, stage, caller and platform contracts
actions: Within two working days, inventory migrated exports, retained synchronous helpers, actual CLI consumers, host claims and producer-owned facts. Assign exact source files; preserve the compiler boundary and additive artifact domain.
acceptance: Every responsibility has a real caller and owner; stage/error/confirmation order is mapped; no compiler change is required.

tasks.title: Capture current source and installed CLI baselines
actions: Build current dists before CLI evidence; record source-only and built CLI results separately. Capture fixture bytes, traces, baseline failures, supported hosts and precommitted workload/resource budgets.
acceptance: No stale dist is treated as current parity; unrelated failures have owners; all P01 source suites and CLI modes are classified.

tasks.title: Source, baseline and release ownership complete
actions: Review the linked leaf evidence and original scope ledger.
acceptance: Every migrated responsibility has an owner; zero required compiler changes; existing source-only tests and correctly built CLI tests classified. Record unrelated baseline failures without fixing them as part of planning.

tasks.title: Freeze prepared-job and coarse host-stage contracts
actions: Specify exact demand-driven steps, lossless tree fields, MCP/catalog requests, staged bytes and refusal/error traces. Specify a stable bundle/reference interface for parallel module and plan work.
acceptance: Bare, preview, confirmed, preview+yes, compiler mismatch, missing worker and competing failures have exact stage expectations; no eager previous-plan reads or live apply.

tasks.title: Extract matching TS job and host wrappers
actions: Extract a prepared TS orchestration route around current helpers without reordering activation, Bun, catalog, render, review or publication. Initially delegate the existing bundle helper through its public boundary. Submit later bundle-internal changes to C04.preparation-join.
acceptance: Current and prepared TS behavior, stdout/stderr, side-effect counts and bytes match; existing library helpers retain their route.

tasks.title: Build full-job differential and trace observers
actions: Implement repeatable current/prepared TS observers and complete-job workload records. Preserve seeds, source/environment, output bytes and stage traces.
acceptance: A reproducible comparator includes external stages and subprocess-ready timing boundaries; no duplicate host execution on effectful inputs.

tasks.title: Prepared TS comparator and stage traces complete
actions: Review the linked leaf evidence and original scope ledger.
acceptance: Prepared TS preserves all existing behavior. Its whole-job cost is the primary comparator; fixtures cover bare/preview/confirmed paths, missing worker fallback and multiple competing failures. No new live apply calls.

tasks.title: Create package-local crate and executable scaffold
actions: Pin tested toolchain, crates, locks and protocol version. Create a standalone crate, explicit binary entry and retained-session scaffold; keep compiler and runtime kernels out of its dependency graph.
acceptance: Native launch/framing proof is recorded within the declared spike; protocol stdout is clean and package-local builds reproduce.

tasks.title: Native crate and retained-session interface ready
actions: Review the linked leaf evidence and original scope ledger.
acceptance: The explicit foundation contract and its evidence are complete.
Algorithm lanes may start from the frozen interface without waiting for the complete host launcher or prepared TS measurement.

tasks.title: Implement lossless admitted-tree transfer
actions: Transfer ordered tagged nodes, explicit presence/null, UTF-16 strings/keys, f64 bits and host canonical numeric spellings. Retain optional/admitted metadata and host JSON syntax diagnostics.
acceptance: Surrogates, own __proto__, enumeration, exponent/negative-zero/nonfinite numbers, depth/size limits and malformed input vectors pass; serde metadata is not the compatibility renderer.

tasks.title: Implement ordered framed request/resume states
actions: Implement Begin/NeedHost/ResumeHost/Prepared/Failed, byte frames, token-once validation, limits, EOF/abort and structured failure mapping. Keep state and module buffers in one process.
acceptance: Truncated/oversized frames, stage replay/skew/unknown versions, mismatched tokens and cancellation fail deterministically; no per-leaf IPC or semantic TS retry.

tasks.title: Build resolved native launcher and host lifecycle
actions: Resolve the selected executable explicitly; launch by argument arrays, bound stderr and resource handling, and release private sessions on success/error/timeout/cancel. Select TS/native before evaluation.
acceptance: Real native launch, missing executable and version mismatch work as specified; one retained process per job; started native failure never falls through to TS.

tasks.title: Native protocol and complete retained-session proof complete
actions: Review the linked leaf evidence and original scope ledger.
acceptance: One working day for toolchain/framing pins after native launch proof; two working days for the complete retained-session interface proof. Malformed/truncated/oversized frames, stage replay, unknown versions, surrogate keys and numeric bits are tested; stdout remains protocol-only. Future command: `cargo test --locked --manifest-path packages/cloudflare/preparation/Cargo.toml`.

tasks.title: Port artifact semantic indexes and identity checks
actions: Port required-field, module/page/callable/test/operation cross-references and compiled identity in source order; preserve unknown/additive trees and source maps.
acceptance: Source fixtures and multiple-error first-failure order match; malformed JSON remains a host parse error.

tasks.title: Port ordered compatibility calculations
actions: Consume current owner-produced target/runtime/compiler/version/capability/secret facts and calculate exact ordered compatibility reasons.
acceptance: Accepted pre-release cases, missing secret names and reason ordering match; no new capability/version authority.

tasks.title: Port release manifest and stamp calculations
actions: Consume raw files and owning package/stamp inputs; calculate sorted roots/files, SHA-256 and mismatch lines with current .tsbuildinfo exclusions.
acceptance: Byte hashes, counts, sorting and mismatch order match; host remains the filesystem/release-fact authority.

tasks.title: Join acceptance and compatibility into native job
actions: Wire ordered artifact acceptance before companions/environment, build lockstep results, deploy compatibility and confirmation/activation requests.
acceptance: Full stage traces retain early refusal points and the distinction between preview compiler warning and confirmed refusal before publication.

tasks.title: Artifact, identity, compatibility and release core complete
actions: Review the linked leaf evidence and original scope ledger.
acceptance: Native vectors match source fixtures and first-error order; malformed host JSON still follows host diagnostics. Dist file hashes/counts and all mismatch lines match existing raw-byte behavior. No new release/capability authority.

tasks.title: Port module inventory, rewriting and graph checks
actions: Implement ordered paths, duplicate-last-wins merging, current import rewrites/markers, link/loadability order, JS text inventory and legacy serialization/digest. Read the typed C04 asset contract for future mixed modules.
acceptance: JS-only keys/text/markers/v1 hashes and current string.length counts match; unresolved/bare imports retain refusal; no binary decoding as JS.

tasks.title: Produce two-phase real build-adapter contract
actions: Implement distinct real Bun-MCP and interfaces-catalog host phases; submit exact bundle/helper/export changes to C04.preparation-join. Keep activation and catalog producers unchanged.
acceptance: Requests preserve module/page checks before worker probe, vendor outputs before Bun, verdict render before catalog and loadability before links; legacy worker-missing path invokes neither phase.

tasks.title: Integrate real host build phases
actions: Join actual Bun and owning catalog results through the stable preparation inputs; preserve host errors and module bytes.
acceptance: No mocked host outputs count as Bun/catalog integration evidence; each external stage occurs once at its current position.

tasks.title: Join module buffers and host resumes in native job
actions: Wire inventory→MCP resume→artifact/verdict render→catalog resume→loadability/links, retaining buffers across requests.
acceptance: Matching legacy-main fallback, cross-stage identities, ordered failures and full module output pass differential tests.

tasks.title: Prove JS-only bundle and real MCP output
actions: Run actual native process, source fixture differential and real MCP local-workerd loadability checks.
acceptance: Real MCP output runs; marker-only checks are insufficient; JS-only bundle bytes/digests match without requiring a Wasm-loader proof.

tasks.title: Native module graph and ordered host build complete
actions: Review the linked leaf evidence and original scope ledger.
acceptance: Same JS text, imports, markers, key order and v1 digest for existing fixtures. Negative unresolved/bare imports preserve refusals. Real MCP output works in local workerd, not only text-marker tests. C04 is required only for mixed Wasm inventory acceptance.

The mixed-asset acceptance remains an explicit P05.mixed outcome gate joined at P11: enabled mixed support requires P05.6 proof; JS-only completion records mixed support as deferred and does not certify it.

tasks.title: Verify mixed text/Wasm preparation after loader proof
actions: Exercise typed byte inventory, generated glue/imports and versioned manifest/digest with actual compiled Wasm; align publication paths with C04 delivery.
acceptance: Exact lengths/hashes, unchanged JS-only v1 output and no Wasm-as-text rewriting are demonstrated in generated installed output.
tasks.activation_condition: mixed-asset support is enabled for this release

tasks.title: Review enabled mixed-asset proof or declared JS-only limit
actions: Review the linked leaf evidence and original scope ledger.
acceptance: Enabled mixed support requires P05.6 real-byte/loader/installed-output evidence; JS-only completion records deferred mixed support, rejects unsupported mixed input before native evaluation, and never claims Wasm adoption.

conditional_dependencies.when: mixed-asset support is enabled for this release

tasks.title: Port resource and deploy-plan calculations
actions: Use the stable bundle-reference contract to calculate resource resolution/order, schedules and deploy plans. Keep unmapped schedules and incomplete activation visible.
acceptance: Plan objects, resource order and all source refusal cases match; this branch does not await full module implementation.

tasks.title: Port exact JSON/TOML rendering and review
actions: Implement UTF-16/JS enumeration-compatible serialization, exact TOML and keyed review diff order. Keep permissive admitted previous-plan fields and validation.
acceptance: Complete bytes match host JSON.stringify/current TOML; nonfinite→null/negative-zero and unknown previous-plan cases pass; no generic serializer parity assumption.

tasks.title: Join plan, prior-plan request and rendered review
actions: Compute current plan before requesting prior plan; render/diff once and retain exact reviewed buffers/digests for later publication.
acceptance: Repeated jobs are deterministic; missing/bad prior plans fail at existing stages; preview+yes still previews; confirmed mismatch refuses after preparation and before writes.

tasks.title: Plan, rendering and review integration complete
actions: Review the linked leaf evidence and original scope ledger.
acceptance: Byte-identical JS-only outputs and reason/diff ordering; preserve unknown fields where today's previous-plan/render path admits them. Repeated jobs deterministically yield the same result. A generic TOML/JSON library's output is insufficient evidence.

tasks.title: Implement contained staging and publication adapter
actions: Validate private temp roots, relative paths, separator/traversal/symlink handling, exact lengths/hashes and reviewed bytes. Keep current confirmed writer/apply and failed-apply/manual-command policy.
acceptance: Cleanup on every exit is tested; private preview staging is allowed but no deployment file publication; current partial-write behavior is classified honestly.

tasks.title: Verify actual job publication and mocked apply
actions: Run bare/preview/confirmed/compiler-mismatch/cancel/error jobs against private directories and existing mocked apply seam.
acceptance: Zero deployment files for bare/preview/mismatch; mocked apply consumes exactly reviewed bundle/config; no live deploy.

tasks.title: Staging, reviewed-write identity and apply handoff complete
actions: Review the linked leaf evidence and original scope ledger.
acceptance: Preview and bare deploy publish zero deployment files; compiler mismatch writes none; successful mocked apply sees the exact reviewed config/bundle. Existing failed-apply envelope/manual command and partial-write behavior remain honestly classified. No live deploy.

tasks.title: Join native build/preview/confirmed CLI selection
actions: Integrate explicit release modes into current CLI using the complete preparation call; retain public synchronous helpers and original activation/apply boundaries.
acceptance: Exactly one stdout envelope, matching exits/code/detail/stderr and no repeated external stages; selected-native startup failure is visible.

tasks.title: Run full CLI and installed-dist differential
actions: Compare current/prepared TS/native using real executable and freshly built installed dist; cover all negative, preview and confirmed mocked-apply modes.
acceptance: No unexplained traces/bytes/errors; library helper routes remain declared and passing.

tasks.title: Actual native CLI consumer complete
actions: Review the linked leaf evidence and original scope ledger.
acceptance: One stdout envelope, matching exits/code/detail/stderr review and no repeated external stages. Run real native executable and generated installed `dist`, not mocked native replies. Public synchronous library helper tests still pass on their declared routes.

tasks.title: Build native packaging scripts and host inventory early
actions: Create package-local reproducible builds, per-supported-host executable inventory, integrity/protocol/release metadata and licenses. Submit package command/export/stamp changes to C04.native-release.
acceptance: Supported hosts derive from claims/consumers; normal installation will use prebuilt executables; scripts do not vendor native binaries into Workers.

tasks.title: Prove supported packaged executable launch
actions: Build/package and launch outside the checkout on every claimed host; test corrupt/missing/wrong-architecture/protocol/release-skew cases.
acceptance: Each supported host has actual build+launch evidence; unsupported hosts remain explicit; package includes executable/license/dist metadata and needs no user compiler.

tasks.title: Native build, publication and supported-host proof complete
actions: Review the linked leaf evidence and original scope ledger.
acceptance: Supported hosts actually build and launch packaged artifacts; wrong architecture, missing executable, corruption, release/protocol skew fail before jobs. Normal users do not require a compiler to install the built package. Native binary is not vendored into Workers.

tasks.title: Measure full-job adoption and resource budgets
actions: Run precommitted current/prepared TS/native workloads including small preview startup, IPC, Bun/catalog, error and memory/temp-disk costs.
acceptance: Recorded complete-call budgets pass or a concrete native consumer/reuse reason with explicit costs justifies adoption; no isolated-core speed claim.

tasks.title: Rehearse fixed release mode and rollback
actions: Test native/TS releases against the same artifacts/manifests/persisted plans and selected backend bootstrap; avoid semantic fallback.
acceptance: Rollback requires no persisted-data conversion; integrity failures never start a second implementation; evidence identifies rollout/default choice.

tasks.title: Measured adoption and rollback decision complete
actions: Review the linked leaf evidence and original scope ledger.
acceptance: Meets the precommitted workload/release budget or records the concrete native consumer/reuse reason. Small previews include subprocess startup. TS rollback does not require artifact, manifest or persisted plan conversion.

tasks.title: Close package coverage and final release ledger
actions: List migrated mechanisms, actual native CLI scope, retained TS library helpers/host stages and any mixed-asset contract version. Recheck source/release evidence and hand final ownership to merge handler.
acceptance: All planned mechanisms and gaps are classified; duplicate TS retirement is separate; eventual merge reconciles living filetree without advancing its checkpoint during planning.

tasks.title: Artifact preparation declared scope complete
actions: Review the linked leaf evidence and original scope ledger.
acceptance: Native selected scope, retained host/library paths and any mixed-asset contract change are explicit. Retirement of TS compatibility is separate. Eventual merge handler reconciles the living filetree; this plan does not advance its checkpoint.

notes: Wave numbers are display groups, not implicit barriers. Only depends_on controls readiness. One active writer per lane; C04 alone writes global manifests and bundle asset assembly.
P03.foundation releases the native interface early; artifact/compatibility/release, module, plan/review and packaging branches can overlap.
P05.mixed reviews the declared release scope at P11; enabling mixed support requires P05.6, while declared JS-only support records mixed adoption as blocked.
